pli-tv-bi-vb-np12:2.2.14: Before this summary line, the Pali reads _(Dutiya) Pattavagga_, “the (second) subchapter on almsbowls”, to indicate the last subchapter of _nissaggiya pācittiya_ rules for the nuns, and then _Pariṇatasikkhāpada_, “the training rule on diverting an offering intended for the Sangha”, to indicate the last rule in the chapter of _nissaggiya pācittiya_ rules. These indications are redundant in the present translation, since I have just pointed out all the missing rules and their equivalents in the _bhikkhu-vibhaṅga_.
